title: InviteMembersDialog
wrapsNative: sheet(isPresented:) with a NavigationStack, a ScrollView around MonarchTagInput, MonarchRolePicker, MonarchAppAccessPicker and MonarchTextField, cancellation and confirmation ToolbarItems, and interactiveDismissDisabled(_:) while sending
summary: A recipe, not a component: invite people by email with a role and app access, from a sheet with Cancel and Send in the navigation bar, reporting the addresses that could not be invited.
whenToUse: When a workspace admin adds people by email from a members screen.
whenNotToUse: For assigning existing members to something, use MonarchAssigneePicker. For a shareable invite link, show the link with a ShareLink instead of a form.
api: .sheet(isPresented: $isOpen) { NavigationStack { ScrollView { form }.navigationTitle("Invite people").toolbar { ToolbarItem(placement: .cancellationAction) { … } ToolbarItem(placement: .confirmationAction) { Button("Send invite") { … } } } }.interactiveDismissDisabled(isSending) }
MonarchTagInput("Email addresses", tags: $emails, separators: [",", " "], maxCount:, validate: { value, _ in … })
MonarchBanner("Some invitations were not sent", message:, tone: .warning)

states.name: empty
states.description: Send invite is disabled until at least one valid address and a role are chosen.

states.name: filled
states.description: Each address is a removable tag; the confirmation button reads Send 3 invites.

states.name: invalid address
states.description: MonarchTagInput refuses the text and shows why, such as “ana” is not an email address.

states.name: sending
states.description: A progress bar shows and the sheet cannot be swiped away.

states.name: partial failure
states.description: A warning banner lists the addresses that failed with the reason; only those stay in the field.

states.name: done
states.description: The sheet closes and "Invited 3 people" is announced.

appearance: A system sheet with a navigation bar; the fields are Monarch's tag input, role picker, app access picker and text field on the canvas background, and failures are a warning MonarchBanner. Every colour is a theme role, so dark and high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: The web InviteMembersDialog is one component with a trigger, controlled open state, email parsing, maxEmails and plural messages. On iOS it is a recipe: a sheet with Cancel and Send in the navigation bar is the system's form pattern, MonarchTagInput splits and checks the addresses, plural text comes from the app's String Catalog, and the app's invite call returns the failed addresses. Android composes the same recipe.
accessibility: The sheet's navigation title is read first; Cancel and Send are the system's toolbar buttons.
MonarchTagInput announces each address added or removed and reads why an address was refused.
MonarchRolePicker and MonarchAppAccessPicker read each choice with its selected state.
Announce the result with AccessibilityNotification.Announcement when the sheet closes.
edgeCases: Keep the addresses that failed in the field so the admin can fix and resend them.
Lock the sheet with interactiveDismissDisabled while sending.
Pasting several addresses at once is split on the separators.
The role picker's compact layout keeps the sheet short; use .cards when roles need their descriptions.
